scope: Current report has 30 figures. Original dated indexes remain historical. Figure 6.2 is before-fix failure; 6.14 is verified retest. Figure 6.13 is deployment-history CI, not published-head CI. Current caption/provenance is authoritative for revision scope.

figures.interpretation: 313 total: 310 passed, 1 failed, 2 skipped. Exit code 1. Skips include live-provider transport and the evidence-host harness.

figures.interpretation: Expected ArgumentException was not thrown for 32 inert ASCII bytes beginning MZ, supplied as sample.pdf/application/pdf. DEF-12 remains OPEN; no successful remediation retest exists.

figures.interpretation: The actual npm run test:member1 execution passed all 19 subtests. These are Node routing/helper checks, not React Testing Library component tests.

figures.interpretation: Visible final widget cases succeed and the runner reports success=true. The full machine stream contains 49 visible unit/widget tests across six files; no device or integrated workflow is inferred.

figures.interpretation: 109 passed and three skipped, across 14 specification files (112 cases). The report All tab excludes skipped cases. Most tests intercept API requests with mocks.

figures.interpretation: Focused browser view of the preserved application screenshot. Weekly hours, duration and synthetic 2030 leave data are visible. API responses were mocked: this is UI evidence, not the blocked Flutter-to-clerk E2E workflow.

figures.title: OWASP ZAP passive scan summary
figures.interpretation: Six deliberate requests to isolated loopback HTTP; no active scan or spider. Two alert types: one Low and one Informational. Zero High/Medium alerts in this scope does not establish absence of vulnerabilities.

figures.title: ZAP alert instances and missing-header detail
figures.interpretation: The Low missing X-Content-Type-Options alert has three instances; authentication discovery has one Informational instance. Fixture headers differ from full production startup. The report false-positive count is not a manual disposition.

figures.title: k6 controlled local execution completes
figures.interpretation: Actual output records completion of 20 iterations with two VUs over ten seconds. The fixture used EF InMemory and mocked AI; PostgreSQL and live Gemini performance were not measured.

figures.title: k6 original machine metrics
figures.interpretation: HTTP failure rate is 0 across 81 requests. Appointment-list p50 is 1.263 ms, p95 23.507 ms, average 3.473 ms. The rate metric fails=81 means 81 false samples for http_req_failed, not 81 failed requests.

figures.interpretation: Line coverage is 23%. Coverlet XML root records 48.91% branches (1326/2711); ReportGenerator displays 48.7% (1293/2655) after its own aggregation. Both originals are retained; this rendering is not a new execution or coverage increase.

figures.title: pytest deterministic and mocked AI suite
figures.interpretation: 98 passed, with nine warnings. Synthetic provider initialization and mocked/deterministic tests do not demonstrate live Gemini accuracy, Golden Case success or response latency.

figures.interpretation: The unchanged original spoof-rejection assertion now passes. This focused execution contains 18 passing tests; genuine PDF/image uploads and the size boundary are also verified. Earlier failure remains Figure 6.2.

figures.title: Real Flutter web submits a genuine bundled PDF
figures.interpretation: The real Flutter UI completed its multipart upload after the web-platform fix. The actual API returned 201 and stored the bytes in PostgreSQL; two remaining genuine attachments were supplied through the API.

figures.interpretation: React uses ClerkId rather than UserId to display the assigned case. The actual human-review status action returned 200 and changed request 12 to COMPLETED.

figures.interpretation: Flutter displays COMPLETED after fetching the real API. Independent SQL confirms request 12, clerk 1 and three binary attachments totalling 7,667 bytes. Actual FastAPI clerk ranking preceded explicit human assignment; Gemini was not used.

figures.title: k6 retest against actual PostgreSQL-backed endpoints
figures.interpretation: Two virtual users over 15 seconds produced 120 requests and zero HTTP errors. Four measured p95 values are below 200 ms in this local synthetic scope. The pre-fix failing run and raw samples remain in the package.

figures.title: Native expanded ZAP report after schema repair
figures.interpretation: Actual Staging API/PostgreSQL target; passive scanning plus finite manual probes. Nine Low missing-nosniff instances and one Informational alert remain. Scan completion is not proof of absence of vulnerabilities.
